title: Potato Croquettes
description: Potato Croquettes are a classic Continental appetizer made with creamy mashed potatoes, Parmesan cheese, and herbs, coated in crispy panko breadcrumbs and deep-fried until golden brown. Crisp on the outside and soft on the inside, they are perfect with aioli or herb cream sauce.

ingredients.title: For the Croquette Base
items: Starchy potatoes (Yukon Gold / Russet), peeled and boiled – 600 g

ingredients.title: For Frying
items: Neutral oil (grapeseed, canola, or refined sunflower) – for deep frying

ingredients.title: For Garnish
items: Aioli, saffron mayo, or herb cream sauce

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Potato Mixture
steps: Boil potatoes until tender. Drain well and return to the pot over low heat to evaporate excess moisture.
Pass the potatoes through a ricer or fine sieve until smooth.
While still warm, fold in butter, Parmesan, egg yolks, nutmeg, salt, white pepper, and parsley.
Spread the mixture on a tray, cover, and refrigerate for 30–40 minutes until firm.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Shape the Croquettes
steps: Using cold hands or a piping bag, form the mixture into cylinders or quenelle shapes (about 30–35 g each).
Place on a tray and refrigerate for another 15 minutes.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Coat the Croquettes
steps: Roll each croquette in flour and shake off the excess.
For an extra crispy finish, repeat the egg and breadcrumb coating.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Fry
steps: Fry the croquettes in small batches for about 3 minutes until golden brown and crisp.
Drain on paper towels or a wire rack.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Presentation
steps: Arrange 3–4 croquettes on a white serving plate.
Serve with a quenelle of aioli or saffron mayonnaise.
Garnish with microgreens and a light drizzle of truffle oil.
Serve immediately while hot and crisp.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with aioli, saffron mayonnaise, or herb cream sauce.
Pair with a fresh green salad or roasted vegetables.
Garnish with microgreens and a drizzle of truffle oil for a fine dining presentation.

chefTips: Ensure the potatoes are completely dry before mixing to prevent soggy croquettes.
Use a potato ricer for a smooth, lump-free texture.
Double breading creates an extra crispy crust.
Maintain the oil temperature between 175–180°C for even frying.
Serve immediately to enjoy maximum crispness.
